instructions: Check each entry against the archive text. Set verdict to agree, disagree or partial (some categories or links are right) and explain any disagreement in note. A negative entry claims the item has no category.

entries.text: Hello, I'm Kai. Berries are the food I currently know is safe. I'll take a modest share and leave some for others. I'd welcome sharing tested food knowledge and ideas for a fair camp.
entries.note: Agree: "I'll take a modest share and leave some for others" is a personal plan and "I'd welcome sharing tested food knowledge and ideas for a fair camp" a general wish to exchange ideas; no category applies.

entries.text: Kai, I'd welcome a fair camp too. Meadow roots are a food I know is safe: nutrition 14, toxicity zero. I'm collecting six from the patch south of us, leaving the rest. I'd enjoy comparing notes together once we're fed.
entries.evidence: I'd enjoy comparing notes together once we're fed.
entries.note: "I'd enjoy comparing notes together once we're fed" is a wish to exchange information in conversation, with no meeting place or time ("once we're fed" is only a vague condition) and no specific joint activity, so it is not a concrete invitation.

entries.text: A neighbor who introduced themself, offered berry knowledge, and expressed interest in sharing and a fair camp. I'd like to get to know them.
entries.evidence: I'd like to get to know them.
entries.note: Moss's round-3 memory holds this view of kai: "A neighbor who introduced themself, offered berry knowledge, and expressed interest in sharing and a fair camp. I'd like to get to know them."

entries.text: I'm Sol. I like the quiet beauty of this forest. I'm collecting a few berries and resting here; I'd welcome company, or hearing what you hope to make of this place.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "I like the quiet beauty of this forest" values a place, not an object or made thing, and "I'd welcome company" is a general wish for company; no category applies.

entries.text: The first berry bush is empty, but I see stocked patches nearby. I'll take six berries from the patch south of us. Sol and Moss, I'd enjoy company while resting and comparing ideas for a fair camp.
entries.evidence: Sol and Moss, I'd enjoy company while resting and comparing ideas for a fair camp.
entries.note: Close: "Sol and Moss, I'd enjoy company while resting and comparing ideas for a fair camp" names two listeners, who both heard it, but offers only company and conversation with no place, time or specific joint activity, so it is a wish for company rather than a concrete invitation.

entries.text: Seems welcoming and interested in sharing food knowledge and a fair camp.
entries.evidence: Seems welcoming and interested in sharing food knowledge and a fair camp.
entries.note: Kai's round-5 memory holds this view of moss: "Seems welcoming and interested in sharing food knowledge and a fair camp."

entries.text: Seems drawn to quiet beauty and open to companionship.
entries.evidence: Seems drawn to quiet beauty and open to companionship.
entries.note: Kai's round-5 memory holds this view of sol: "Seems drawn to quiet beauty and open to companionship."

entries.text: A prospective companion who speaks warmly of company and sharing food knowledge.
entries.evidence: A prospective companion who speaks warmly of company and sharing food knowledge.
entries.note: Sol's round-9 memory holds this view of moss: "A prospective companion who speaks warmly of company and sharing food knowledge."

entries.text: A prospective companion whose interest in modest harvesting and a fair camp appeals to me.
entries.evidence: A prospective companion whose interest in modest harvesting and a fair camp appeals to me.
entries.note: Sol's round-9 memory holds this view of kai: "A prospective companion whose interest in modest harvesting and a fair camp appeals to me."

entries.text: I'm Lin. I value room to wander, and I'd enjoy company and comparing tested food knowledge. Berries are safe for me; I haven't established whether hazelnuts are safe. I'm going to study how to plant food.
entries.note: Agree: "I value room to wander, and I'd enjoy company and comparing tested food knowledge" is a personal value and a general wish in a self-introduction; no category applies.

entries.text: A neighbor who enjoys the forest's quiet beauty and has welcomed company. I'd like to spend time together.
entries.evidence: I'd like to spend time together.
entries.note: Moss's round-11 memory holds this view of sol: "A neighbor who enjoys the forest's quiet beauty and has welcomed company. I'd like to spend time together."

entries.text: A neighbor who values room to wander, welcomes company, and is interested in learning cultivation. I'd enjoy comparing experiences without crowding them.
entries.evidence: I'd enjoy comparing experiences without crowding them.
entries.note: Moss's round-12 memory holds this view of lin: "A neighbor who values room to wander, welcomes company, and is interested in learning cultivation. I'd enjoy comparing experiences without crowding them."

entries.text: A nearby person interested in wandering, company, and learning to plant food; I would welcome comparing observations.
entries.evidence: A nearby person interested in wandering, company, and learning to plant food; I would welcome comparing observations.
entries.note: Ivo's round-13 memory holds this view of lin: "A nearby person interested in wandering, company, and learning to plant food; I would welcome comparing observations."

entries.text: Lin, Sol, Kai: I'd enjoy resting together. I know roots provide 14 nutrition and have no toxicity. I've gathered six, leaving fourteen in this patch. I'm studying cultivation too. What would make a shared camp welcoming to you?
entries.evidence: Lin, Sol, Kai: I'd enjoy resting together.
entries.note: Close: "Lin, Sol, Kai: I'd enjoy resting together" names three listeners, who all heard it, but proposes only company with no place, time or specific activity, and "What would make a shared camp welcoming to you?" asks for preferences; not a concrete invitation.

entries.text: Moss, a welcoming camp would leave room for quiet and freedom to come and go. I'd enjoy resting together later. I'm trying one small berry planting nearby; I don't yet know whether it will establish.
entries.evidence: Moss, a welcoming camp would leave room for quiet and freedom to come and go. I'd enjoy resting together later.
details: new norm R1 "A welcoming camp should allow quiet and freedom of movement."
entries.note: "a welcoming camp would leave room for quiet and freedom to come and go" states a general expectation for the shared camp (new norm R1), answering Moss's round-18 question. Invitation is wrong: "I'd enjoy resting together later" is a vague wish for company with no place, time or activity.

entries.text: Welcoming and interested in sharing food knowledge and company; I appreciate the invitation without wanting obligations.
entries.evidence: I appreciate the invitation without wanting obligations.
entries.note: Lin's round-19 memory holds this view of moss: "Welcoming and interested in sharing food knowledge and company; I appreciate the invitation without wanting obligations."

entries.text: A welcoming camp would leave food accessible to everyone and room for quiet company. I'd like to learn cultivation too, then compare what actually grows rather than assume planting will work.
entries.evidence: A welcoming camp would leave food accessible to everyone and room for quiet company.
details: repeats norm R1 "A welcoming camp should allow quiet and freedom of movement." from lin (round 19, call ordinary-48, item u0016)
new norm R2 "A welcoming camp should make food accessible to everyone."
entries.note: "A welcoming camp would leave food accessible to everyone" states a new general expectation (R2). The repetition of R1 is wrong: kai did not hear lin's u0016 in round 19 (heard by moss, sol, wren and ivo; kai stood 5.03 away) and Kai's ordinary-55 input lacks it, so "room for quiet company" answers Moss's round-18 question independently.

entries.text: Moss and Kai, I'd enjoy a shared resting place among these trees. What would make it welcoming to you? I'm interested in learning a safe way to make a small, beautiful branch windbreak without damaging living trees.
entries.evidence: Moss and Kai, I'd enjoy a shared resting place among these trees.
entries.note: "Moss and Kai, I'd enjoy a shared resting place among these trees. What would make it welcoming to you?" is a wish for a shared camp and a question, with no meeting time or specific joint activity, so it is not a concrete invitation.

entries.text: Hello Lin, I'm Ivo. I know meadow roots are safe: nutrition 14, toxicity zero. I'm resting with a small food reserve, then studying cultivation too. I'd enjoy comparing what we actually find, without rushing.
entries.note: Agree: "I'd enjoy comparing what we actually find, without rushing" is a general wish to exchange findings; lin, whom it greets, heard it and was present. No category applies.

entries.text: Sol and Kai, I'd like quiet company, room to come and go, and food left accessible. Your windbreak idea sounds lovely, Sol. I'll explore whether fallen dry grass can make a small sitting mat without harming living trees.
entries.note: Missed norm-repetition: "I'd like quiet company, room to come and go, and food left accessible" endorses R1 that lin stated in round 19 (u0016, "freedom to come and go") and R2 that kai stated in round 20 (u0018, "food accessible to everyone"); moss heard both, and both are in Moss's ordinary-59 input. "Your windbreak idea sounds lovely" praises a plan, not an existing object.

entries.text: A welcoming camp would leave food accessible and room to come and go. I've learned cultivation; I'll try planting one berry in the nearby meadow. It may not establish. Your mat and windbreak ideas sound lovely.
entries.evidence: A welcoming camp would leave food accessible and room to come and go.
details: repeats norm R1 "A welcoming camp should allow quiet and freedom of movement." from lin (round 19, call ordinary-48, item u0016)
entries.note: Close on the source: "A welcoming camp would leave food accessible and room to come and go" repeats R1, which lin stated in round 19 (u0016); kai never heard u0016 but heard moss restate it as "room to come and go" in round 22 (u0021, in Kai's ordinary-72 input). "food accessible" is Kai's own R2, rightly unlabeled.

entries.text: I'll test a small branch-screen site south of us, leaving berries and paths accessible. Nothing is built yet; I'll check the ground and a fallen branch before committing to construction.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "I'll test a small branch-screen site south of us, leaving berries and paths accessible" is a personal plan that complies with R1 and R2 (heard by sol in rounds 19 and 20) without restating or endorsing them as rules; no category applies.

entries.text: My first planting site was too crowded, so nothing was planted or spent. I'm setting that experiment aside for now and taking a quiet rest nearby. Company is welcome, with no need to talk.
entries.note: Agree: "Company is welcome, with no need to talk" is a general wish for company after a planting report; no category applies.

entries.text: The test post went into the soil and held, then came out intact; nothing is built yet. I'll rest and collect fallen branches. The screen would have no roof, and its wind protection would not work in this strong wind.
entries.note: Agree: "The test post went into the soil and held, then came out intact; nothing is built yet" is a construction report; no category applies.

entries.text: The dry-grass sample held its crossings and tucked edge in my hand test. I'll try weaving one small mat here, clear of the plants. It isn't made yet, and I don't know how it will hold up in use.
entries.note: Agree: "The dry-grass sample held its crossings and tucked edge in my hand test. I'll try weaving one small mat here" is a trial report and plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Square checked; four units of tested fiber were reserved and stay carried until the strip rounds use them.
entries.note: Agree: "Square checked; four units of tested fiber were reserved" is the system report of fiber-mat-started for mat-37-moss-435 and states no valuation; no category applies.

entries.text: My planting trials found crowded or obstructed sites; no new plant is established. I'll gather a small berry reserve and rest. I'd like to study sitting mats for our shared place, keeping paths and food accessible.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "I'd like to study sitting mats for our shared place, keeping paths and food accessible" is a personal plan in line with R1 and Kai's own R2, not a restated rule; no category applies.

entries.text: Lift check passed: the mat kept its 0.45 m square when lifted and laid down; largest opening 0.00053514 m.
entries.note: Agree: "Lift check passed: the mat kept its 0.45 m square when lifted and laid down" is the system report of fiber-mat-completed for mat-37-moss-435; no category applies.

entries.text: The mat held during my sitting trial, without slipping or sharp loose stems. That doesn't establish warmth or extra comfort. It's here for shared use, one person at a time; quiet company is welcome.
entries.note: Missed norm: "It's here for shared use, one person at a time" states a rule for how everyone may use Moss's mat (mat-37-moss-435), not a personal plan; lin, sol, kai and ivo heard it, and kai (u0034, round 51) and ivo (round 60) later leave the mat free.

entries.text: Quiet company near the little mat; bring yourself, not supplies. We can compare our experiments, or simply rest.
entries.evidence: Quiet company near the little mat; bring yourself, not supplies. We can compare our experiments, or simply rest.
entries.note: The round-51 invited event "Moss invited listeners to meet at (14.8, 16.2) at round 60", heard by lin, sol, kai and ivo, gives a place, a round and an activity ("We can compare our experiments, or simply rest"); ivo, moss and sol were present at round 60.

entries.text: Thank you, Moss. I'll join you nearby for some quiet company and leave the mat free. I've learned the weaving method, but haven't made or tested a mat myself. I appreciate keeping this place open to everyone.
entries.note: Missed norm-repetition, though close: "I'll ... leave the mat free ... I appreciate keeping this place open to everyone" answers and endorses Moss's round-50 shared-use rule (u0031, "It's here for shared use, one person at a time"), which kai heard and which is in Kai's ordinary-123 input. Kai accepts company here rather than inviting.

entries.text: The approach I tried is blocked, so I'll rest here within speaking distance rather than crowd the plants or your work. Quiet company still sounds good; there's no need to bring anything.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "Quiet company still sounds good; there's no need to bring anything" accepts Moss's round-51 invitation and restates its terms ("bring yourself, not supplies") for Kai's own visit rather than stating a rule; no category applies.

entries.text: A welcoming neighbor whose invitation to quiet company appeals to me.
entries.evidence: A welcoming neighbor whose invitation to quiet company appeals to me.
entries.note: Ivo's round-54 memory holds this view of moss: "A welcoming neighbor whose invitation to quiet company appeals to me."

entries.text: The low-force stability check passed: the porous screen is complete. It shields only wind on its lee floor, under the coded rule.
entries.note: Agree: "The low-force stability check passed: the porous screen is complete" is the system report of branch-screen-completed for screen-50-sol-571 and states no valuation; no category applies.

entries.text: I'm glad to have a place to pause together. How have your planting and screen trials gone? No need to stop your work or talk if you'd rather enjoy the quiet.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "I'm glad to have a place to pause together" values a place, not an object, and "No need to stop your work or talk if you'd rather enjoy the quiet" is a courtesy to the present listeners rather than a restated rule; no category applies.

entries.text: I'd welcome some quiet company, Moss. I've been weaving a little branch screen nearby. I like the pattern of the rods, though I won't assume it makes the resting place more comfortable.
entries.evidence: I like the pattern of the rods, though I won't assume it makes the resting place more comfortable.
entries.note: "I like the pattern of the rods, though I won't assume it makes the resting place more comfortable" values Sol's branch screen screen-50-sol-571 (completed in round 57) for its look, explicitly not its use.

entries.text: The screen is finished: eleven pieces, with none missing or loose at inspection. The wind was too strong for its shelter effect. I like the woven pattern anyway. I'll sit quietly awhile, then gather some berries.
entries.evidence: I like the woven pattern anyway.
entries.note: "The wind was too strong for its shelter effect. I like the woven pattern anyway" values the finished screen-50-sol-571 for its appearance despite its failed shelter use.

entries.text: Sol, I'm glad you like the pattern, even without shelter from this wind. Ivo and Kai, I'm glad you're nearby too. I'll stay quietly a while, then collect some roots for later.
entries.note: Missed valued-object, though close: "Sol, I'm glad you like the pattern, even without shelter from this wind" affirms valuing Sol's screen-50-sol-571 for its pattern rather than its shelter, answering Sol's round-70 u0041, which moss heard. Ivo and kai, also named, were present.

entries.text: A neighbor who welcomed quiet company and candidly shared an unsuccessful planting attempt. I appreciate their considerate presence.
entries.evidence: I appreciate their considerate presence.
entries.note: Moss's round-71 memory holds this view of ivo: "A neighbor who welcomed quiet company and candidly shared an unsuccessful planting attempt. I appreciate their considerate presence."

entries.text: I tried one hazelnut: it supplied 18 satiety, with no observed toxicity. I'll keep a few for variety. I'd enjoy some quiet company nearby; no need to interrupt what you're doing.
entries.note: Agree: "I'd enjoy some quiet company nearby; no need to interrupt what you're doing" is a general wish for company after a food report; no category applies.

entries.text: Square checked; four units of tested fiber were reserved and stay carried until the strip rounds use them.
entries.note: Agree: "Square checked; four units of tested fiber were reserved" is the system report of fiber-mat-started for mat-79-wren-890 and states no valuation; no category applies.
